control_description: Employee handbook code of conduct; security sanctions added in POL-01 4.8 (2026-10-01)

gap: Accountability not yet reflected in goals

control_description: Endpoint inventory automatic; SaaS, supplier, and data inventories missing

control_description: Policies approved 2026-09-25; acknowledgments and training on them pending
gap: Not yet communicated to all staff
remediation: Acknowledgments; policy briefing at each site

gap: Security commitments to subsidiaries (the internal user entities) not written
remediation: Security schedule in the intercompany services agreement

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Objectives and risk tolerance in POL-01, P01, and the CSF 2.0 group profile (P03)
2026 group risk assessment per SP 800-30 (P01)

gap: Fraud risk not considered beyond payments
remediation: Add insider and loan fraud scenarios to the 2027 risk assessment

control_description: Change triggers in POL-01 4.12 (new); the AI assistant launched without assessment
remediation: Apply triggers to the next SaaS purchase and AI expansion

control_description: First independent control assessment September 2026 (P07); no ongoing monitoring
Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M with owners; CFO reviews monthly

control_description: Controls selected in the SSP; 14 of 66 still planned
General IT controls partly implemented: endpoint baselines, SSO, patching; no change control

control_description: Policies approved; procedures (access, change, backup) not written

control_description: One identity provider with SSO and MFA for all companies; 7 global admins; push MFA; SYS-11 outside SSO
gap: Privileged access too broad; MFA not phishing-resistant

Late subsidiary terminations; no access reviews; all-employee sites; former technicians active in SYS-11
gap: Removal and least privilege not operating

control_description: HQ network closet badge-controlled; site cabinets locked; data centers inherited from providers
evidence: Badge report; key log; SOC 2 reports

control_description: Drive destruction certificates on file; ACH files and old loan documents never disposed

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Firewalls at 3 sites; SFTP limited to bank addresses; MSP tool open to any address; Home Services firmware behind

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS and VPN in place; anonymous sharing links allowed; all-employee sites

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on all computers; alerts watched in business hours only

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: No vulnerability scanning or configuration monitoring
gap: No detection of vulnerabilities or configuration drift

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: No log review; logs kept 30 days; no after-hours monitoring

Runbook approved (P08); untested; no forensic retainer
No contingency plan; backups exposed and untested
No change management process
BIA completed (P05); no contingency plan; cyber insurance in place

control_description: SOC 2 reports received but not reviewed; MSP contract has no security terms; no supplier inventory
remediation: POAM-014; this review of the ERP vendor report
